intent: To illustrate that Israel's population is growing while most other developed nations are not.

requirements.question: Is the declining-with-age pattern required to support the growth message, or can the video just show one or two age groups?

units.claim: Younger age groups are larger than older age groups; this is the pattern the video uses to convey that Israel's population is growing.
accept: The age distribution has a broad base: younger cohorts have much larger bars than older cohorts.
Relative values decrease steadily as age increases.
The youngest listed age group is far larger than the oldest listed age group.
units.evidence: The bars must visibly decrease from the youngest age group toward the oldest age group.

optional_valid: The video may note that the youngest female cohort (0-4) is only slightly larger than the next youngest female cohort (5-9): 0.7438 vs 0.7262.
The video may emphasise that the male/female difference is small compared with the age-group differences.

g0_data_completeness.selection: all role=bar data rows; annotation rows excluded
